ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the blue line segments form a quadrilateral, and an exterior angle is marked at each vertex: the upper-left corner is (x−11)°, the right-side vertex is (x+10)°, the lower-right/bottom-side vertex is 31°, and the lower-left corner is (2x−42)°. Reasoning: When taking one exterior angle at each vertex of a polygon, the sum of the exterior angles is 360°. Therefore (x−11)+(x+10)+31+(2x−42)=360. Combining like terms gives 4x−12=360, so 4x=372, x=93.
